# ExHLS v0.2.5 - Table of Contents

> Elixir package for handling HLS streams

## Pages

- [ExHLS](https://ex-hls.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [LICENSE](https://ex-hls.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [ExHLS.Chunk](https://ex-hls.hexdocs.pm/ExHLS.Chunk.md): A struct representing a media chunk in the ExHLS demuxing engine.

- [ExHLS.Client](https://ex-hls.hexdocs.pm/ExHLS.Client.md): Module providing functionality to read and demux HLS streams.
It allows reading chunks from the stream, choosing variants, and managing media playlists.
